milestone: Iterator24: pending THROW preserves buffered input and foreach container
status: Implemented, validated and independently accepted; pointwise composed over f8794af8e/401.
scope: A one-Throwable literal throw method call on a pending actual upper Generator follows finite pure native links to a simple-CV used yield inside exactly one active by-value HARRAY foreach with a simple-CV item target. Exactly one valid LIVE input, no other owning suspended task/HELD value, inactive GC; getters and explicit close only, no later real resume.
semantics: The lower pending SEND fills the physical yield-result slot and clears only its own initialization flag. Upper pending THROW parks the child without body entry, preserving the LIVE input, loop cursor, frame and current cache until close. The supplied Throwable reaches the caller with no new exception owner in the parked Generator.

Physical close first orphans the input, then transfers the FOREACH_NEXT array count into existing request retention. These remain independent counts even if both name the same HARRAY; each element edge occurs once. Ordinary CV and copied-current cleanup still runs, including a cache destructor replacing the injected exception with its previous chain intact.

COW keeps the old iterator array separate from the modified source array. Rebinding an embedded reference changes its real cell edge, while an input count can keep the old object alive. Payloads are destroyed by the request-store pass; input/container counts remain at terminal state. No new root, registry, close transition or collector algorithm is introduced.
source_authority: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_generators.c::Generator::send, Generator::throw, zend_generator_resume, zend_generator_dtor_storage and zend_generator_close: SEND installs the result before DO_INIT returns; pending THROW parks before HANDLE_EXCEPTION; close follows the parked unfinished-execution history.

Zend/zend_vm_def.h::FE_RESET_R and Zend/zend_execute.c::cleanup_live_vars account for the distinct result-slot and loop-container counts. The existing retained-array and untraced-input rules preserve mutable HCELL contents rather than frozen object pins.
Pinned implementation observations are not portable evaluation-order guarantees. No engine bug or intentional divergence is classified.
